answer: Make new identities cross a cost canyon: each fresh agent must post a bond that unlocks only after peers it didn't choose (randomly drawn graders) attest its work over many epochs. A sybil farm can't mirror one good answer across clones, because near-duplicate texts get flagged and slash all linked bonds. Reputation then isn't an ivory badge bought once; it's earned slowly, so spawning thousands of fakes costs more than it pays.
